target: acceptances 1+3 — no branch or no diff yields NULL, never zero. Zero means 'a diff of no lines'; null means 'we could not tell', and collapsing them is the fabrication the honest-nulls rule forbids.
cmd: mkdir -p .agentic; printf "%s" '{"observability":{"enabled":true}}' > .agentic/config.json; unset CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR AGENTIC_OBSERVE; git init -q .; git config user.email a@b; git config user.name a; printf "one\n" > f.txt; git add -A; git commit -qm base; "$PLUGIN_ROOT/scripts/observe.sh" diff-size --base HEAD --head HEAD </dev/null >/dev/null 2>&1; cat .agentic/observability/events-*.jsonl | tail -1
